title: Assessing Positional Discrepancies Between As-Built GPR Surveys and Operator GIS Records for Low-Voltage Cable Networks in Vojvodina

record.title: Assessing Positional Discrepancies Between As-Built GPR Surveys and Operator GIS Records for Low-Voltage Cable Networks in Vojvodina
record.abstract: Low-voltage distribution cable networks in Vojvodina were largely installed between 1965 and 1990 and digitised from paper sketches of variable quality. This study quantified positional discrepancies between independent GPR-based cadastre surveys and operator-held GIS records for 47.3 km of low-voltage cable routes across nine settlements of varying population density. A 500 MHz GPR system was used, with RTK-GNSS referencing. Discrepancies were decomposed into horizontal offset, depth-of-burial error and missing-segment rate. Mean horizontal offset was 0.81 m with a 95th percentile of 2.34 m; depth errors averaged 0.24 m. Missing segments constituted 8.4% of total surveyed length. Discrepancy magnitude was significantly correlated with settlement age and with the decade in which original records were created. Rural settlements with records predating 1980 showed missing-segment rates exceeding 15%. Findings support a prioritised re-survey programme targeting pre-1980 rural records.
